title: Complete SRD ancestry option table modeling
description:
Problem

Ancestry records are broadly present, but at least Dragonborn is missing critical structured option data.

Audit example

ancestry:dragonborn references the Draconic Ancestry table, but the record does not include the table rows mapping dragon type to damage type and breath weapon. There is also no corresponding table record. A consumer cannot determine the dragonborn breath weapon or resistance options from structured pack data.

Task

Complete ancestry option and table modeling.

Implementation guidance

- Start with Dragonborn Draconic Ancestry.
- Scan all ancestry records for source references to tables, choices, variant options, or structured lists.
- Represent ancestry option tables either as top-level table records linked from ancestry/feature records or as structured child data.
- Preserve source row text, damage types, breath weapon shapes, and provenance.
- Ensure the coverage gate accounts for ancestry-related tables and options.

Regression cases

Add tests for:

- Dragonborn Draconic Ancestry table rows.
- Dragonborn Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance linkage to the chosen ancestry.
- Any other ancestry option table/list detected by the source inventory.

Acceptance criteria

- Dragonborn structured options are usable from generated records.
- No ancestry source table is only referenced by prose without a structured mapping.
- Existing ancestry record ids remain stable.
close_reason: Linked ancestry option tables to ancestry traits via per-trait tableRefs (Dragonborn Draconic Ancestry -> table:draconic-ancestry); added kindSchema validation + ancestry-unlinked-table audit invariant + tests. PR #208.
